name: Umehara Masayoshi
source:
Protagonist's best friend since childhood, who has an interest in Japanese idols. He often purchases photo books of them and shares them with the protagonist. His family owns a sushi shop, which he plans to inherit.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amagami]AniDB[/url]]
